response.justification: Bogdan has 20 years of software engineering experience significantly exceeding the 15-year minimum and is currently working directly on AI-agent infrastructure at re:cinq, demonstrating engagement with cutting-edge AI technologies. However, his resume shows Staff Engineer and Senior Developer titles rather than the Director-level seniority explicitly required for this Principal Engineer role. Additionally, he lacks the preferred Master's or PhD in AI/ML, and while entrepreneurially minded, he has limited evidence of building strategic AI products or serving in a strategic advisory capacity to enterprise customers.
strengths: 20 years of software engineering experience with demonstrated technical expertise across web, mobile, infrastructure, and high-performance systems, significantly exceeding the 15-year requirement

Currently working on AI-agent infrastructure and MCP code generators at re:cinq, showing direct hands-on engagement with cutting-edge AI technologies and agentic workflows relevant to the AI Strategy focus

Proven entrepreneurial and technical leadership through founding and maintaining GISCollective since 2016, combined with knowledge-sharing through conference talks, workshops, and community contributions
concerns: Resume shows Staff Software Engineer and Senior Developer titles rather than Director-level or Principal Engineer titles explicitly required for the role, indicating a potential seniority level mismatch
No Master's degree or PhD in AI/ML field despite being a preferred qualification; holds two Bachelor's degrees with neither specifically focused on artificial intelligence or machine learning

Limited evidence of building or owning strategic AI products and platforms, or experience advising enterprise customers on AI adoption; current AI work appears focused on infrastructure and tooling rather than product innovation

key_factors.factor: Current AI infrastructure and agent development work
